objects.description: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has encrypted C2 communications with RC4.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also leveraged encryption and compression algorithms to obfuscate the traffic between the system and C2 server, methods observed included RC4, AES, XOR with 0x5a, and LZO.(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)
objects.description_fa: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) ارتباطات C2 را با RC4 رمزگذاری کرد. سیستم و سرور C2، روش‌های مشاهده‌شده شامل RC4، AES، XOR با 0x5a، و LZO بود.(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015) (Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022) (Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)
